title: French press body asks competition watchdog to take action over Google AI
excerpt: A French press association has asked the country's competition watchdog to ‌take action against Google's artificial intelligence-generated article summaries,...
content_html:
By Inti Landauro

PARIS, Aug 11 (Reuters) - A French press association has asked the country's competition watchdog to ‌take action against Google's artificial intelligence-generated article summaries, which ‌the trade group says deprive newspapers and magazines of readers.

The group has ​called on the regulator to make a decision similar to that which ordered Meta to put forward a payment plan and resume talks with traditional media seeking fees for the ‌use of their content ⁠by AI tools.

The Alliance of General Information Press, which represents French newspapers and magazines, opposes ⁠the recent rollout of AI-generated article summaries by Google without consultation, the alliance said in a statement.

Google did not respond ​immediately to ​a request for comment.

Four years ​ago the competition watchdog ‌forced Alphabet's Google to pay for using French press articles on its platforms, including its search engines.

Google was fined €500 million ($576.8 million) after the copyright dispute.

"The unilateral deployment of new uses of press content, without prior authorisation or dedicated remuneration, ‌disregards these commitments," the alliance said, ​adding that the communications regulator, Arcom, ​has estimated traffic on ​their sites has fallen by between 33% ‌and 38% because of AI-generated ​summaries.

"The fact that ​AI is built upon media content means one single thing: this information has considerable value," Marc Feuillee, the ​alliance's president, said ‌in the statement. Publishers demand this value is shared, ​he added.

($1 = 0.8669 euros)

(Reporting by Inti LandauroEditing by ​Sudip Kar-Gupta and David Goodman)

content_html_zh:
英蒂·兰达罗

巴黎，8 月 11 日（路透社）——法国一家新闻协会已要求该国竞争监管机构对谷歌人工智能生成的文章摘要采取行动，该行业组织称这剥夺了报纸和杂志的读者。

该组织呼吁监管机构做出类似于命令 Meta 提出付款计划的决定，并恢复与传统媒体的谈判，寻求通过人工智能工具使用其内容的费用。

代表法国报纸和杂志的新闻联盟在一份声明中表示，该联盟反对谷歌最近在未经协商的情况下推出人工智能生成的文章摘要。

谷歌没有立即回应置评请求。

四年前，竞争监管机构迫使 Alphabet 旗下的谷歌为其在其平台（包括搜索引擎）上使用法国媒体文章付费。

版权纠纷后，谷歌被罚款 5 亿欧元（5.768 亿美元）。

该联盟表示：“在没有事先授权或专门报酬的情况下，单方面部署新闻内容的新用途，无视这些承诺。”并补充说，通信监管机构 Arcom 预计，由于人工智能生成的摘要，其网站流量下降了 33% 至 38%。

“人工智能建立在媒体内容之上这一事实意味着一件事：这些信息具有相当大的价值，”联盟主席 Marc Feuillee 在声明中表示。 他补充说，出版商要求共享这一价值。

($1 = 0.8669 euros)

（Inti Landauro 报道，Sudip Kar-Gupta 和 David Goodman 编辑）
